title: Pin the runners-config tables ticfac actually reads
description:
Close the sharpest coupling ticfac has to ticks: two hand-rolled readers over an
UNPINNED file, one of which feeds a shell.

Today:
- `internal/reconcile/toml.go:49` ReadGateCommands parses `[testing.commands]`
  from the target repo's `.tick/runners.toml`. Its values are executed at
  `internal/reconcile/gate.go:469` via `sh -c`. Nothing pins the table's shape.
- `internal/profile/roles.go:39` ReadRoles parses `[roles.<name>]` and
  `[roles.<name>.tiers.<tier>]`, two keys each. Nothing pins it either.
- `contracts/runners-config-contract.json` pins `[sandbox].image` and
  `[orchestration].max_parallel` — two tables NOTHING reads. Its own parity test
  says so: `internal/contracts/parity/runners_config_test.go:11` claims "ticfac
  reads neither file yet", which is no longer true.

So the contract pins what is unused and leaves unpinned the highest-privilege
input in the system.

Do:
- Extend the vendored contract to pin the two tables production actually reads:
  the shape of `[testing.commands]` entries and of `[roles.*]` / tiers. Follow
  the existing pin discipline — contracts/ is digest-pinned and NEVER hand
  edited, so this is an upstream ticks change first, then a re-pin here. If the
  upstream change cannot land in this tick, say so in your RESULT file as an
  UPSTREAM ticks FINDING and pin what you can.
- Make both readers validate against the pinned shape and REFUSE with a message
  naming the file, the table and the offending line, rather than silently
  reading two keys and ignoring the rest.
- Fix the stale parity-test comment.
- Keep the two readers separate. The gate reader must remain unable to read
  anything but `[testing.commands]`: routing must never become a second way to
  authorise a command line (internal/profile/roles.go:10-24 states this).

acceptance_criteria: The pinned contract covers [testing.commands] and [roles.*] including tiers; both readers validate against it and refuse a malformed table naming file, table and line; a test drives a malformed entry of each kind through the refusal; the gate reader still refuses every table but [testing.commands]; the stale 'ticfac reads neither file yet' comment is gone; go test -short -timeout 45m ./... green.
